title: Escalation Heatmap + Cost Lens: Rollout Simulator & Access Remediation Prototype
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, interactive "heatmap + cost lens" view for the Console that surfaces recent role escalations and correlates them with per-route cost spikes. The view should integrate with the rollout simulator so admins can preview impact of granting or revoking roles (what-if), run an access review flow, and propose automated remediation suggestions. Goal: reduce time to detect and remediate privileged grants that materially increased token cost or triggered reliability regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable heatmap rows representing workspace users/roles with time-series cost overlays
Rollout simulator exists as a timeline scrubber allowing admin to apply a hypothetical role change and preview cost + error-rate delta
'What-if' permission preview shows downstream resources impacted (routes/models/dedicated pools) with links to runbooks
Access review flow can be started directly from a heatmap cell and produces a shareable remediation plan
Prototype validated with engineering on backend event surface required (grant/revoke events, per-request model usage, CPI/cost attribution) and a security sign-off queue is created
design_notes: Heatmap rows collapse by principal -> role -> route to keep the canvas narrow for multi-workspace views
Color encoding: escalation recency (hue) + cost delta magnitude (saturation). Hover reveals absolute token count, cost, and sample request ids
Rollout simulator is implemented as an overlay machine: timeline scrubber + cartilage that shows two parallel traces (actual vs simulated). Default simulation window is 72 hours

Remediation suggestions are driven by heuristics: if a role grant coincides with >20% cost or >2x error rate for a route, surface 'Recommend revoke' or 'Scoped rollback' with one-click create-PR template for RBAC change
Privacy: all sensitive identifiers are redacted by default; maintain a toggle for full identifiers accessible only to admins with audit-read scope
Accessibility: keyboard-first timeline controls and ARIA labels for heatmap cells; color choices pass WCAG contrast for red/amber/green states
decisions: Use compact sparkline mini-charts for per-cell cost trend to avoid expensive rendering of full charts
Prototype will assume the backend provides per-request model id and workspace id for attribution; if not available, fallback to route-level approximations
Initial rollout of the feature will be workspace-admin only behind a feature flag and opt-in analytics
